env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '

cd m
# Public fields with interface types and fields of generic structs exist
# upstream. They must survive the verifier and the complete export.
logos build ./...
logos eject -o out
exists out/fields.go
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/stdlibfields

go 1.27

-- m/fields.lgo --
package stdlibfields

import (
	"container/list"
	"crypto/x509"
	"database/sql"
)

func ElementValue(element *list.Element) any {
	return element.Value
}

func CertificateKey(certificate *x509.Certificate) any {
	return certificate.PublicKey
}

func NullValue(value sql.Null[int64]) int64 {
	return value.V
}

func NullValid(value sql.Null[int64]) bool {
	return value.Valid
}

// Existing public methods are the control for the same imported type.
func Next(element *list.Element) *list.Element? {
	return element.Next()
}
